sources.label: WyoVote 113 County Report for Weston (legislators serving that session)

holders.notes: Official 2020 SOS statewide House summary, House District 2 (right column beside House District 1; that district's Total is not used): Hans Hunt (R) Total 4,121. Official Weston share 1,789; official Goshen share 1,106; official Niobrara share 1,226. Hunt is the January 2021 holder (elected 2020). The 2021 legislator vote file records 399 counted votes for Hunt and 6 for JD Williams; the 2021 113 report lists both, and the 2022 report lists only Williams. Exact resignation or appointment date is not yet collected. term_end 2021-12-31 is a placeholder so January 2022 shows Williams; it is flagged medium.
